name: Industrial design
task: specifying, sourcing or prompting the objects that furnish a room: taps, switches, lamps, curtain rods, storage, seats, tables, kitchen objects, frames, vases and pots
description: Industrial design styles as rules for the objects of a home: form, materials, finishes, textures, hardware and manufacture, with one signature object for each of eight object categories. A closed vocabulary names each object type with its parts, forms, materials, finishes and textures. An object net maps each interior style to an industrial style and a surface for each category, so that each object in a moodboard resolves to a style, a material and a texture.

vectors.label: Hand finish
vectors.high: visible marks of the hand and the tool

vectors.label: Material warmth
vectors.high: warm wood, wool, leather and clay

vectors.label: Chromatic intensity
vectors.low: the natural colour of the material, or white and black

assets.purpose: One fixed still life of household objects on a plinth (a pendant lamp, a wall switch, a basin tap, a kettle, a vase and a side chair) in the forms, materials and finishes of the style.

knobs.label: Ornament level
knobs.description: The share of the visible surface that carries applied ornament: 0 = none, 1 = every part.

knobs.label: Material warmth
knobs.description: The mean warmth of the materials in view, from the warmth of each vocabulary material: 0 = steel and glass, 1 = wood, wool and clay.

knobs.label: Finish gloss
knobs.description: The gloss of the main finish in gloss units at 60 degrees: 0 to 10 = matte, 10 to 70 = satin, 70 and more = gloss.

knobs.label: Era blend
knobs.description: How far an object moves from a period original: 0 = a period piece or a faithful reissue, 1 = a contemporary object that only quotes the period.

knobs.label: Hardware weight
knobs.description: The section of the visible hardware: the diameter of a rod, a pull, a tap body or a tube leg.

knobs.label: Edge radius
knobs.description: The typical radius of the outside edges and corners of a body.

knobs.label: Metal tone
knobs.description: The one colour of visible metal across taps, switches, rods, pulls and frames.
